description: Connectivité Etablissements scolaires - Dep7791 is a dataset listed in Opendata de Grand Paris Sud open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Opendata de Grand Paris Sud. Recensement annuel par le Ministère de l'Éducation Nationale de la Connectivité des Établissements du 1er degré (élémentaire = maternelle + primaire) et du 2nd degré (collège + lycées) resserré sur les départements du 77 et 91. Clé unique code de l'établissement; pas d'adresse de géolocalisation. Coverage: Grand Paris Sud (Essonne and Seine-et-Marne). The portal shows 4,196 records. The portal shows 2020-12-10 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-grandparissud-fr-portal.
